name: Manugraph India Limited
summary: Manugraph India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of printing machines in India and worldwide. It provides newspaper web offset, folder, and packaging and converting machines, as well as involved in manufacture of engineering components. The company also exports its products. In addition, it offers after-sales services and installation services. The company was formerly known as Manugraph Industries Limited and changed its name to Manugraph India Limited. Manugraph India Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Mumbai, India.
